2607.12713.title: Line-Anchored Feedback Cuts Token Costs and Improves Correctness in AI Code Editing
2607.12713.paper_summary: Generated tokens are a direct driver of the cost, latency, and energy of generative AI (GAI) code editing. We show the format of feedback is a lever on all three. We compare two deliveries of the same requested changes: a holistic prompt (control) versus the structured, line-anchored export of FileMark (treatment). FileMark is a VSCodium extension for inline comments on any file. In a paired experiment line anchoring cut generated tokens by 22% (Claude Opus) and 58% (Claude Sonnet), reaching 24%-80% on files of 100 lines or more, with four of seven models generating significantly fewer tokens after multiple-testing correction. Correctness rose where models had headroom: +2.0 points pooled and +5 to +7 points for three of five local models. An exploratory experiment in which the harness, not the GAI model, applies function-level patches shows the correctness benefit grows further when the edit-application burden is lifted: local-model correctness on 100+ line files roughly triples under anchoring. Line-anchored feedback reduces what stronger models spend and improves what weaker models get right.
2607.12713.paper_summary_zh: 生成的標記是生成式人工智慧（GAI）代碼編輯的成本、延遲和能耗的直接驅動因素。我們展示了反饋的格式對這三者的影響。我們比較了兩次相同請求變更的交付：一個是整體提示（對照組），另一個是結構化的、以行為基準的FileMark導出（處理組）。FileMark是一個用於任何文件的行內註釋的VSCodium擴展。在一個配對實驗中，行為基準將生成的標記減少了22%（Claude Opus）和58%（Claude Sonnet），在100行或更多的文件中達到24%-80%，七個模型中有四個在多次測試校正後生成的標記顯著減少。當模型有提升空間時，正確性提高：總體提高2.0分，三個本地模型提高5到7分。在一個探索性實驗中，當應用功能級補丁的是裝置而非GAI模型時，正確性的好處進一步增長：在行為基準下，100行以上文件的本地模型正確性大約增加三倍。行為基準的反饋減少了更強模型的支出，並改善了較弱模型的正確性。
2607.12713.author: William Franz Lamberti et.al.
